# Dropbox

> Connect Zenflow to Dropbox to store, search, and manage files securely.

<span className="set-page-badge-extended" />

<Note>
  This extended integration requires a paid Zencoder account.
</Note>

## Overview

The Dropbox integration allows the AI agent to interact directly with your Dropbox cloud storage. Search, read, upload, and organize files, and share document links directly within your workflows — making document management and collaboration fully automated.

## Connecting Dropbox

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open Settings & Integrations">
    Navigate to **Settings → Integrations** in the Zenflow sidebar.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Find Dropbox">
    Locate **Dropbox** in the Integrations Catalog.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Click Connect">
    Click the **Connect** or **\[+]** button on the Dropbox card.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Authorize Connection">
    Authenticate and authorize Zenflow to access your Dropbox workspace via the secure OAuth popup window.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Integration enabled">
    Once authenticated, Zenflow is ready to use your Dropbox workspace.
  </Step>
</Steps>

## What the Agent Can Do

* **Search** — Search for files and folders across your Dropbox cloud storage
* **Read & Download** — Retrieve content and download documents securely
* **Upload & Create** — Store new files and generate folders automatically
* **Share** — Create and retrieve shared download/preview links for files

## Example Use Cases

* Automatically upload finished reports or summaries from your AI agent to a specified Dropbox folder
* Search your team's knowledge assets on Dropbox to answer complex customer inquiries
* Share download links for design mockups directly to your Slack or Teams channel
* Maintain a secure backup of project receipts and invoices automatically on Dropbox
